node.label: Partial atrioventricular canal defect
node.definition: A specific combination of heart defects including a primum atrial septal defect and cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet. There is not an inlet ventricular septal defect present. There are two valve annuluses and two valve orifices.

evidence.snippet: Acrofacial dysostosis, Cincinnati type: Partial atrioventricular canal defect (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
